feedback: Reviewed before racing, so no outcome is stated for this candidate. Its controller and geometry match the iteration 8 design, which scored 686.6, the best raced result. The only change is controller.kd 0.7 back to 0.6. Iteration 8 gave 20 of 20 finishes on the oval (progress 0.997, steering_oscillation 0.24) and 20 of 20 on the s-bend (progress 0.997, steering_oscillation 0.31), with slalom progress 0.40. Iteration 10 raised kd to 0.7 and scored 675.4: both finishable tracks still finished 20 of 20, but slalom progress fell to 0.31. That is evidence for kd 0.6 over 0.7. Iteration 9 (base_speed 1.4) cost s-bend finishes (17 of 20) and scored 639.2, so speed 1.2 stays. Sensors at y 0.06 (iteration 8) also outperformed y 0.04 (iteration 6, s-bend oscillation 0.397 against 0.314). Because this is the final iteration, no further development race can test changes. The candidate is the most robust raced design for the unseen track, and it should race as it stands.
requested_changes: Keep controller.kd at 0.6, sensors at y 0.06 (x -0.03 to 0.03, sensor_size 0.016), base_speed 1.2, kp 1.5, ki 0.02 and line_loss last_direction. Iteration 8 is the only raced design with 20 of 20 finishes on both finishable tracks at the best score.
Do not raise controller.base_speed. Iteration 9 at 1.4 cost s-bend finishes (17 of 20), and an unseen track of a different shape is more likely to expose the same speed limit.
